bio: Housed in a listed building dating back to 1903, this restaurant is run in a down-to-earth yet professional and carefully considered way – and that goes for the atmosphere, the service and the food. The name (Swedish for field) is a nod to the Nordic roots of owner Björn Swanson and the ingredient-led style of cooking cultivated by the kitchen team. The seven-course modern set menu draws on international influences and impresses with dishes such as excellent-quality and perfectly cooked scallop served with a wonderfully harmonious buttery Barigoule foam with saffron. The combination of braised cucumber, Earl Grey and quince vinegar, which brings a pleasant freshness, is also excellent.
